description: Navigate the browser to a URL (auto-creates a session if needed). Returns as soon as the page commits (url, title, loadState "commit" or "domcontentloaded"); no snapshot by default. Call browser_snapshot for the page structure and [ref=eN] refs, or pass snapshot:"full" to get them inline (that waits for the document to parse).

returnSnapshot.description: Legacy inline snapshot (tree modes). Prefer the "snapshot" param, which returns ref-based AI snapshots.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session or creates a new one.

snapshot.description: Inline AI snapshot of the new page. Default "none": a terse answer as soon as the page loads. "full" waits for the document to parse and returns [ref=eN] refs; otherwise call browser_snapshot when you need the page structure.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_navigate
